installerNetworkIsolation: Normal shell execution: macOS Seatbelt cannot spawn the setuid system ps used by the real exit check. Offline package-manager policy is retained; separate direct DSH CLI is tested under OS isolation.

scope.installer: Full lightweight script executed with offline package-manager policy, not OS network isolation; system ps is setuid on macOS and cannot be spawned in Seatbelt.
scope.directDsh: Cold install and config composition executed under OS network isolation with empty isolated store.
scope.runtimeDiscovery: Existing independent Homebrew Node was on PATH; the existing DSH root was explicitly configured. No global dsh CLI was present. Discovery of DSH-bundled Node was not tested.
scope.platforms: Only macos-arm64 lightweight end-to-end trial completed here. Windows/Linux lightweight archives were generated and hash-checked, not accepted by this trial.
scope.qualification: Development test only; full native acceptance remains unverified.
